title: Pool of Radiance
build: version 1.0, eight D64 images (archive.org d64_Pool_of_Radiance_v1.0_1988_SSI_Disk_1_of_4_Side_A); BOOT prints "POOL OF RADIANCE, VERSION 1.0"

records.c: The spells outside combat, seven bytes each for spells 1 to 56 and the item powers 57 to 67 (an item's byte 14 less $17): the time's base (top two bits the unit: 0 minutes, 1 turns, 2 hours, 3 days), the time per caster level, whom it is cast on (spell_targets: bit 0 the caster, 1 a member chosen, 2 or 7 the party, 0 combat only), the timed effect's kind (bit 7 for a cleric's spell), its message ($80 for none), and the handler. BLESS: 6 minutes, the party, kind 1, IS BLESSED, party_effect. The combat spells all have combat_only_spell ($1467). Items 60, 61, 64 and 65 point at not_used_here.

The item powers 57 to 67: 57 the potion of speed (HASTE's effect on one), 58 a d4+8 heal that cures poison or disease first (no item has it), 59 the POTION OF GIANT STRENGTH (strength 21), 60 the JAVELIN OF LIGHTNING, 61 the WAND OF PARALYZATION, 64 the NECKLACE OF MISSILES and 65 the WAND OF MAGIC MISSILES (nothing here), 62 the POTION OF HEALING (2d4+2), 63 the DUST OF DISAPPEARANCE (its kind 71 on the whole party), 66 nothing (kind 0; the CLOAK OF DISPLACEMENT's 89 works through its own kind 133 instead), 67 the MANUAL OF BODILY HEALTH: kind 4 for 24 hours with READS, whose end gives kind 7 for 30 days.
58, a heal no item has: a member chosen, kind 0, no time, heal_potion_8.
59, the POTION OF GIANT STRENGTH: the caster, kind 38, 63 minutes, giant_strength.
60, the JAVELIN OF LIGHTNING: the caster, kind 0, no time, not_used_here.
61, the WAND OF PARALYZATION: the caster, kind 0, no time, not_used_here.
62, the POTION OF HEALING: the caster, kind 0, no time, healing_potion.
63, the DUST OF DISAPPEARANCE: the party, kind 71, no time, dust_party.
64, the NECKLACE OF MISSILES: the caster, kind 0, no time, not_used_here.
65, the WAND OF MAGIC MISSILES: the caster, kind 0, no time, not_used_here.
66, no item (the cloak of displacement uses its own kind): the caster, kind 0, no time, item_power_effect.
67, the MANUAL OF BODILY HEALTH: the caster, kind 4, 24 hours, item_power_effect.

The timed-effect kinds with a routine here, zero-terminated: 4, 38, 12, 14, 22, 34, 50, 128-135, 136, 138, 139, 7, 43, 44, 57, 62 and 15. The camp's call_effect_handler finds the kind here and calls the routine from camp_kind_lo and camp_kind_hi with its value: when an item is readied or put away, or when an effect whose fourth byte has bit 7 ends (end_effect).
camp_kinds' routines, low bytes.
camp_kinds' routines, high bytes.
The conditions CURE LIGHT WOUNDS heals here, checked from the last: $85 unconscious, 1 OK, 3 and 9. One unconscious comes round (1). Unlike the combat's list, no $84: a dying member is not healed.
ENLARGE's strength percentage by caster level, from level 1 at $9B22: 0, 1, 51, 76, 91 and 100 (strength 18/00 to 18/100). The first byte is level 0's.
STRENGTH's die by the class part found first, from the fighter's down: magic-user 4, cleric 6, thief 6, fighter 8.
The kinds CURE DISEASE ends, from the last: 31, 57, 50, 44, 43 and 34: CAUSE DISEASE's (34, and 43 and 44, which it brings), the mummy's rot (50 and 57) and 31, the helpless.
Six bytes after disease_kinds: 1, 51, 76, 91, 100 and $FF, enlarge_percents' figures again. No code refers to them.

Experience at the start of each level, the drain's xp_table again (SPELLE02's), for RESTORATION: levels 1 to 9, twelve bytes a level, three for each class part (magic-user, cleric, thief, fighter), high byte first.
RESTORATION's cleric first-level spells by level 0-6, as the drain's.
RESTORATION's cleric second-level spells by level 0-6: 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, one more than training's at levels 2 to 4, as the drain's.
RESTORATION's cleric third-level spells by level 0-6.
RESTORATION's cleric to-hit figures by level 0-6.
RESTORATION's magic-user first-level spells by level 0-6.
RESTORATION's magic-user second-level spells by level 0-6.
RESTORATION's magic-user third-level spells by level 0-6.
RESTORATION's magic-user to-hit figures by level 0-6: 40 for levels 1 to 5, where training has 39.
RESTORATION's thief to-hit figures by level 0-9: 40 for levels 1 to 4, where training has 39.
RESTORATION's fighter to-hit figures by level 0-8, as training's.

Whom the spell goes on, by spell_targets: bit 7 the party (A = $FF, carry set); bit 0 the caster, or a member chosen when the whole party is casting (caster $FF); bit 1 a member chosen (choose_member); bit 2 the party. Carry clear when the choice is cancelled or the spell has no target here.
Carry clear, A = $FF.
The caster itself, unless the whole party is casting.
The frame, the camp's lower window and picture, the party panel, and a member chosen.
The member the spell is on (spell_target) loaded (load_member).
A d4s rolled (roll_dice, X = 4 sides) into heal_amount.

Ends kind A on spell_target, counting each into spell_count: the timed effect when there is one (end_effect), then IS CURED (message $5B); otherwise the kind in the character's list ($6BAD, has_item_type), taken out (drop_kind). A = spell_count, 0 when there was nothing to cure.
No timed effect of the kind: the member's own list is looked at instead.
IS CURED for the member.
The kind in the character's own list rather than a timed effect.
A = spell_count.
The member's name and spell message X (SPELLN00 number) in the framed lower window.
print_name_spell with message message_number.
spell_message in the low lower window, then the rest redrawn.
The condition A for the member, stored.
X more hit points, full and now.

The spell's timed effect on spell_target: kind spell_kind (none when 0), its time the base plus the per-level figure times caster_level, carried up into turns (10), hours (6) and days (24) while the count passes 63. An effect of the same kind already there is ended when the new one has no time (for ever), or when the old one has a time no longer than the new one's, and a free entry then gets the kind, the member, the time and the fourth byte (a_2879, or the caster level when that is 0). An old one that lasts for ever or longer stays, and nothing is added. The message (spell_data's fifth byte plus $39) is shown unless it is negative.
The count over 63 divided by the next unit's size (time_units), the unit one higher.
The unit's bits (unit_bits) on the count.
The entry: kind a_2873 on spell_target with time effect_time; ADD_EFFECT's entry from item powers and ending effects (renew_effect) too.
A free entry ($4900 = 0) for the new effect; none, nothing added.
The message unless a_28CB is negative.
The size of each next unit: 1, 10 minutes a turn, 6 turns an hour, 24 hours a day.
The unit's bits: $00 minutes, $40 turns, $80 hours, $C0 days.

For a disease's or a poison's routine at its end: unless a cure ended it (spell_count not 0), the same kind ($6E6E) is put back with time X and a fourth byte of $FF, so it ends again and the routine runs again. A cure returns from the routine as well (the two PLAs).

Items 60, 61, 64 and 65 (the bolt, the paralysing wand, the necklace of missiles and the wand of magic missiles) outside combat: spell_cast counted back, so the charge is not used and nothing happens.
The RTS for not_used_here and for give_effect and cure_light_camp.

DETECT MAGIC, PROTECTION FROM EVIL and GOOD (and the 10' radius ones), RESIST COLD and FIRE, READ MAGIC, SHIELD, FIND TRAPS, DETECT INVISIBILITY, INVISIBILITY, KNOCK, PRAYER, BLINK, PROTECTION FROM NORMAL MISSILES: the effect alone (give_effect) on the target. KNOCK's kind is 0, so casting it here gives no effect.
BLESS and INVISIBILITY 10' RADIUS: give_effect on every member, slot 7 down to 0.
CURE LIGHT WOUNDS: 2d4 (1e: d8) when the member's condition is in heal_conditions_camp (heal_listed), then the party panel and IS HEALED.
IS HEALED (message $5A).
heal_amount given (heal) when the member's condition is one of heal_conditions_camp; N set otherwise. The camp's own $1FC8 calls it too.
A more hit points, up to the full; an unconscious member ($85) becomes OK. A = 0.
ENLARGE: strength 18 with enlarge_percents' percentage for the caster level, through set_strength_to.
The member loaded, then set_strength_from.

Strength a_2872 with percentage a_2876 for the member, unless its own is higher, or the same 18 with a percentage as high: the old strength plus 100 (or, at 18, the old percentage), with bit 7, is the effect's fourth byte (a_2879), to put back at the end. A member that already has a strength effect (kind $26) or an Enlarge (kind $0C) is left as it was, unstored; otherwise the new figures are worked out (new_strength) and the effect given.
REDUCE: ends an Enlarge (kind $0C, cure_kind).
FRIENDS: charisma 2d4 higher, at most 25, the old figure with bit 7 kept to put back, the character stored and the effect given.

SLOW POISON: only on a poisoned member (kind $37 in its list): condition 9, at least 1 hit point, the poison's damage (kind $0F) put back on for 10 minutes as a renewing effect (renew), and the spell's effect with the caster level and bit 7 as its fourth byte, so poison_ends runs at its end. In combat the fourth byte lacks bit 7 and nothing runs.
No poison, no spell.
MIRROR IMAGE: d4 images as the fourth byte.

STRENGTH: the member's first class part from the fighter's down (to the cleric's: a pure magic-user falls to index 0 without its level being looked at) picks the die (strength_dice), rolled onto its strength. 18 or more is 18; a fighter's points over 18 become 10 percent each on its percentage, at most 100. Then set_strength_to.

ANIMATE DEAD: up to the caster level of the dead ($83) party members, from slot 0, of any race: each becomes an NPC zombie (side bit 7, $6BA3 = 2, $6B98 and $6BA4 0, memorised spells wiped, full hit points, $6BB8 marked, type 4 undead, movement 6, condition 3) with ANIMATE DEAD's kind $20 in its list, and the spell's effect.
The next member.
CURE BLINDNESS: ends kind $21, CAUSE BLINDNESS's.
CURE DISEASE: ends each of disease_kinds; a member at condition $21 becomes OK (1).
DISPEL MAGIC: for each kind from 63 down to 1 on the member, held with a fourth byte other than $FF, dispel_roll with its low four bits as the level; a success ends it.

The chance to dispel an effect of level A: 50, plus 5 for each level the caster is above it, less 2 for each level below; carry set when a d100 (0-99) is that or more. Its STA writes the chance into the CMP at $AAA7.
CMP #chance: the operand is written by dispel_roll.
The chance, written here by dispel_roll.
REMOVE CURSE: ends BESTOW CURSE (kind $24). With none to end, the member's first cursed item ($6D83 bit 7), from item 15 down, loses its curse and the item is stored.
HASTE: up to the caster level of members, from slot 7 down, hasted (haste_member), the caster level with bit 4 as the fourth byte. The first LDA #$4D is overwritten at once.

A member, while the count lasts: unless cure_kind finds kind $4D (77) to end, which only a monster file gives (the giant mantis's), and so never does, HASTE's effect, one year older ($6B74) and AGES (message $47). A member already hasted is hasted again and ages again.
RESTORATION: for a member drained ($6BA1, levels lost), IS RESTORED (message $5E); the hit points the drain took ($6BA2) shared by the levels lost come back; then restore_level.

The class part to give back a level: the smallest experience figure in xp_table_camp above the member's own (best_found), whose part the member has (its level not 0; otherwise the search goes on above that). The experience becomes that figure, the part one level up, and the figures are worked out again from this file's tables as the drain does (SPELLE02's rebuild): turning figure, spell counts with wisdom's extras, to-hit, fighter level, and the level shown the highest of the parts.
Six NOPs, as in the drain's rebuild.
wis_one twice.
A wisdom chance, as the drain's wis_extra.
The to-hit figure ($6B71) becomes A when A is higher.
restore_level's best experience figure, 24 bits.
restore_level's figure being compared.
The class part restore_level found.
Item 57, the potion of speed: HASTE's effect for 5d4 minutes on the one using it ($1C as the fourth byte, one member), through haste_member, so it ages a year.
Item 58: ends the poison (kind $37) and SLOW POISON (kind $16) on a poisoned member; otherwise cures disease, and with none cured heals d4+8.
No poison: CURE DISEASE's work; nothing cured, a d4+8 heal.
heal_listed, and IS HEALED when it healed.
Item 59, the POTION OF GIANT STRENGTH: caster level doubled, strength 21 (percentage 101, which counts only at 18) through set_strength_from.
Strength X with percentage A, through set_strength_from.
Item 62, the potion of healing: 2d4+2.
Item 63, the DUST OF DISAPPEARANCE: its kind 71 (IS INVISIBLE) on the whole party for 3d4+8 turns.
Items 66 and 67: the table's effect alone, $FF as its fourth byte so its routine runs at its end. 66's kind is 0: nothing.
Kind 4 (the manual's reading, 24 hours) at its end: kind 7 for 30 days, $FF fourth byte.

Kind 7 at its end, the manual's: constitution one higher, the character stored and IS AFFECTED (message $59). From 20, kind $3E (62) goes on for an hour, renewing: a hit point back each hour (regenerate_hour). Constitution 15 or 16, or 17 and up for a member with a fighter's part, adds the level shown in hit points (add_hp).
The character stored with its entry (store_both).
Kinds 38 (STRENGTH and the potion) and 12 (ENLARGE) at their end: the strength put back from the fourth byte (over 100: 18 and that less 100 as the percentage), new_strength.
The strength's figures (strength_index), compute_combat_stats, stored.
compute_combat_stats and stored.
Kind 14 (FRIENDS) at its end: the charisma from the fourth byte.
The character stored.

Kind 22 (SLOW POISON) at its end, run when its fourth byte has bit 7 (as the camp casts it): the poison's damage (kind $0F) ended; a member still poisoned (kind $37) loses it from its list and dies (poison_kills).
Kind 34 (CAUSE DISEASE): weaken, then sicken.
Kind 43 at its end: renewed for 6 hours (renew_effect, X = $46); strength one lower and IS WEAKENED (message $3A) while it is 4 or more; at 3 kind $1F, the helpless, goes on the member's list.
Kind $1F into the member's list (add_kind).
Kind 44 at its end: sick_damage, and helpless when it found the member below 2 hit points.
Kind 15 (poison's damage) at its end: renewed for 10 minutes ($41); a member with 2 or more hit points loses 1 (lose_hp), the party panel and the member shown again.
LDA #$00, never reached: the JMP before it goes on.
Under 2 hit points: no damage.
The party panel and the member, then the rest redrawn.
The party panel, then the member loaded.
Kind 50, the mummy's rot, at its end every 10 days: renewed for 10 days ($CA), then the_rot_heals: IS HEALED and one hit point back. The routine that rots (rot_charisma) is never reached.
Kind 57, the mummy's rot's other effect, at its end: renewed for 30 days ($DE) and nothing else.

Never called: no entry of camp_kinds points here. ROTS (message $77) and charisma 2 lower; when that would be below 3, DEAD instead (poison_kills). It is what the 1st edition's mummy rot does, and what kind 50 would do with $A4 in camp_kind_lo instead of $97.
DEAD ($83) for the member, stored, and GOES DOWN (message $65).
Kind 62 (constitution 20) at its end: renewed for an hour ($46), then a hit point back (the_rot_heals).
IS HEALED (message $5A), one hit point back (heal), the panel again: for kind 62, and for the mummy's rot (kind 50).

Kinds 128-130, 133, 134, 136, 138 and 139, items' own powers: when the item is readied ($6D82 bit 7) the kind in its byte 14 ($6D8A) goes into the member's list (add_kind); otherwise it comes out (drop_kind).

Kind A into the member's list ($6BAD, ten places), searched from the last place down: into the first empty place met, unless it is in a place above that one already (one further down is not seen, so the kind can be there twice); stored. With all ten full it becomes a timed effect that lasts for ever, fourth byte $7F (renew).
Kind Y with time X and fourth byte A on the member in hand ($6DB4), with no message (a_28CB bit 7).
The kind into the empty place.
Kind A out of the member's list; not in it, its timed effect ends (find_entry, end_effect).
Kind 131, the gauntlets of ogre power: readied, strength 18/100 as an effect (kind $26) at caster level 12; put away, the strength effect ends.
Kind 132: unless the item is being put away, or the low nibble of its byte 14 is the wearer's alignment, it comes off and the wearer takes the high nibble in damage (lose_hp).

A hit points lost; at 0 or below the member is unconscious ($85) with 0. The name, IS HIT FOR, the figure, POINTS OF DAMAGE and FROM MAGIC ($48, $53, $57) are printed, and GOES DOWN for one now down. Poison's damage (kind 15) comes here a point at a time.
Kind 135: a readied item on a wearer with strength below 19 comes off, with message 6 at the bottom.
